        self.dense1 = Dense(units=128, activation='relu')
        self.dense2 = Dense(units=64, activation='relu')
        self.dense3 = Dense(units=10, activation='softmax')

        x = self.conv1(inputs)

        x = self.conv3(x)
        x = self.pool1(x)

        # Second block
